products.title: Products · Imaginne Lab
products.description: Explore 3D printed miniatures, home pieces and gifts from Imaginne Lab. Photos, interactive 3D views and prices in Canadian dollars.

footer.text002: 3D printing studio dedicated to miniatures, organization, and made to order gifts.

hero.text005: Miniatures, organization, and personalized gifts, made to order in our studio and delivered ready to use.
hero.alt001: 3D printed light-up photo frame showing a family photo, glowing on a table, made by Imaginne Lab

advantages.text002: No inventory sitting around, each piece starts to exist the moment you order it.
advantages.text004: We sand, paint, and check every piece before packing it.
advantages.text006: Protective packaging so your piece arrives safe and sound.

products.text003: Explore our 3D printed pieces and order directly from the studio.
products.empty: New pieces are on their way. Check back soon.

process.text003: to a piece of your own.
process.text004: A conversation, a design, a few careful layers. Discover how we turn what you imagine into something you can hold.
process.text009: Reach out on Instagram, describe the piece, and send references if you have any. We work out the details together.
process.text010: Send a sketch, photo or inspiration.
process.text011: Tell us how you will use the piece.
process.text012: Agree on the details before we start.
process.text015: I have an idea for a custom piece.
process.text023: We draft the file and adjust size, color, and finish with you. The design takes shape around what you need.
process.text024: A model made for your project.
process.text025: Size, color and finish chosen together.
process.text037: Layer by layer, your piece becomes real. We review the print and finish it by hand, paying attention to the small details.
process.text038: Built one layer at a time.
process.text040: Hand finishing for the final touch.
process.text052: Packed with care and shipped to your door. We arrange the delivery details with you on Instagram.
process.text055: Ready to use, give or display.

customization.text002: If you can imagine it, we can print it.
customization.text003: From a small birthday gift to a decor piece you will not find in any store, every order is modeled from scratch to fit your idea exactly.
customization.alt001: Illustration: the Imaginne Lab mascot, a smiling light bulb, next to a small Julia nameplate being 3D printed, with colour, size and engraving options
